proposed_fields.description: Structured list of the practice's published office and center locations (address, city, region, postal code).
proposed_fields.why_needed: Many decisions (sales targeting, territory coverage, clinical service delivery) require explicit, queryable office addresses; existing fields provide only HQ or unstructured descriptions and cannot represent multiple published practice locations and centers.

proposed_fields.description: List of published fax numbers the practice advertises for referrals or general contact.
proposed_fields.why_needed: Referral and intake workflows often rely on published fax numbers; no existing account field captures multiple published faxes in a machine-friendly form to drive outreach or integration checks.

proposed_fields.description: Name/label of the patient portal as published on the public site.
proposed_fields.why_needed: Knowing the branded portal name helps map patient communication channels (portals, bill-pay) to vendor integrations and reduces discovery time when qualifying digital-front-door capabilities; existing fields do not capture portal branding.

proposed_fields.description: Phone number specifically published for billing-office contact on patient-facing pages.
proposed_fields.why_needed: Billing and revenue-cycle matching often requires the specific billing-office phone (separate from HQ/mainline); no existing field distinguishes a billing contact number from the general company phone.
